notes: Conservative EPS tier capacities for first-pass CubeSat optimization.
max_solar_generation_w is interpreted as achievable average sunlit generation capability at beginning-of-life with reasonable deployables for the supported bus range.
max_battery_capacity_wh is energy storage capacity available to the payload+bus loads (packaging and DoD/derating handled separately in the formulation).

field_descriptions.max_solar_generation_w: Available electrical generation capability during sunlit portion (used for P_solar_available >= P_solar_req).
field_descriptions.max_battery_capacity_wh: Packaged battery capacity (used for C_batt_available >= C_batt_req).
field_descriptions.max_peak_bus_power_w: Maximum supported peak regulated bus power delivery (used for peak-power feasibility).
field_descriptions.eps_avg_self_consumption_w: Average EPS overhead consumption used in housekeeping power closure.
field_descriptions.eps_mass_kg: EPS dry mass proxy for system mass closure.
field_descriptions.eps_volume_u: EPS packaging volume proxy for system volume closure.
